name: Lamb Kofta Flatbreads
description: Spiced lamb skewers, griddled and piled into warm flatbreads with garlicky yoghurt and a quick pickled onion. No protein or carb tags in this file: the index infers them from the ingredients.

recipeInstructions.text: Toss the red onion with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt and set aside to pickle.
Mix the lamb, grated onion, half the garlic, the spices and parsley with plenty of seasoning. Shape into 8 sausages around skewers.
Cook on a hot griddle or barbecue for 10–12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Stir the remaining garlic into the yoghurt. Warm the flatbreads and fill with the kofta, yoghurt, pickled onion and salad leaves.
